items.title: Champion’s corner: KC Current win first NWSL Championship with 2-1 stunner over Spirit
items.summary: Current’s opener came direct from a corner kickDebinha, Trinity Rodman trade goals in stoppage timeWashington Spirit lose third consecutive NWSL finalRead Jeff Rueter’s minute-by-minute reportIt took five years, 90 minutes and a goal for the ages, but the Kansas City Current have their first-ever NWSL championship.Riding a wave of momentum created by a 54th-minute Olimpico from midfielder Vanessa DiBernardo, and capping it off with an all-important breakaway winner from Debinha, the Current silenced the partisan, sellout crowd at the heavily-favored Washington Spirit’s home ground with a 2-1 victory on Saturday.
